model_choices.credit_return: separate delayed token from queue departure; no invented reverse payload flit
model_choices.niu_buffer: one shared data pool per physical NIU, NoC and direction, across VC queues; not BN independently per VC
model_choices.l1_banking: scenario: interleaved 16B blocks modulo16; mono-bank stress uses bank0 for every block
model_choices.memory_service: 32B flit uses two 16B bank actions; independent NoC read/write interfaces share bank resources. Per-interface paired-lane interval is 1/eta_n cycles; each involved bank is held for this service quantum (an explicit conservative occupancy assumption below the public peak). Interleaved blocks finish together; mono-bank blocks finish at one and two service quanta. Tags carry individual16B completion offsets. Local compute uses eta=1; 16B control accesses conservatively consume one full quantum. DRAM16B blocks finish sequentially at16/(24*eta_d)cycles
model_choices.dram_service: all endpoints/NoCs of one physical channel share read+write byte service; ideal single FIFO service with no row/refresh model; not a calibrated GDDR6 controller
model_choices.niu_processing: once per packet before its first flit, on per-NIU command/response preparation resource; separate from 5cycle hops
model_choices.dateline: scenario: reset dateline bit at dimension turn, flip after crossing wrap edge in that dimension; static buddy0, request class0, notification class1, response class3. Exact vendor dateline positions not established; liveness tested within this declared scheme
model_choices.compute_micro: exact integer x*2 then x+3; local read, deterministic compute service and local publish/write; explicit RF scratch holds one1KiB payload per compute task, sequential tasks per tile; no hardware GEMM performance inference
model_choices.transaction_ids: statically distinct stage scopes load/peer/notify/token/output; same scope next request waits previous scope completion, at most five IDs per tile/NoC; individual ACK never assigned to arbitrary request
model_choices.source_release: paid local observation after all source reads; next load may issue before peer ACK
model_choices.receive_release: consumer reads into paid RF scratch then sends explicit nonposted token to producer; next peer issue waits observed token
model_choices.full_module_status: not yet lowered or performance qualified
